tiers.name: Thela
tiers.note: Dada's old cart on the pavement. One helper, no seats.

tiers.name: Bara thela
tiers.note: A second cart bolted on, a wider canopy and a row of stools.

tiers.name: Pavement dhaba
tiers.note: A takhta, plastic chairs and the nihari deg in front of the old "To Let" shop.

tiers.name: Pakki dukaan
tiers.note: The "To Let" shutter goes up: tables inside, your board over the door, tube lights.

tiers.name: Family restaurant
tiers.note: You take the shop next door and the floor above: a family hall, AC, a proper kitchen.

tiers.name: Famous restaurant
tiers.note: Neon over the whole building, a rooftop under the stars, queues down Burns Road.

tracks.name: Staff
tracks.note: Hire the next person on the team. Each one is paid a daily wage.

tracks.name: Training
tracks.note: Your team works faster: every order is ready sooner.

tracks.name: Seating
tracks.note: More places to sit. Seated customers wait longer and families stay.

tracks.name: Kitchen
tracks.note: Bigger kettles, more burners, a better tawa: food cooks faster.

tracks.name: Comfort
tracks.note: A pedestal fan, then a cooler, then AC. Comfortable people wait longer.

tracks.name: Storage
tracks.note: An ice box, then a fridge, then a cold room: less stock spoils overnight.

tracks.name: Signboard
tracks.note: A painted board, tube lights, truck art, then neon: more people stop.
